- $ G $: Gravitational constant  
- $ m_1, m_2 $: Masses of the two objects  
- $ r $: Distance between the centers of the two objects

- Newton first developed this law in the late 17th century after observing a falling apple and reflecting on the nature of gravitational attraction.
